stem.text: Which row correctly explains how the structures of phloem sieve tube elements and xylem vessel elements are related to their functions as transport systems?

A.text: contain mitochondria to make ATP for the active loading of sucrose into the phloem; cell walls are thickened and contain lignin which makes xylem vessels waterproof

B.text: contain no nucleus so that dissolved solutes can move easily through cells; end walls between cells are perforated so that water can move easily through xylem vessels

C.text: end walls between cells are perforated so that dissolved solutes can move between cells; lignin in cell walls gives strength so that xylem vessels do not collapse due to transpiration pull

D.text: no end walls between cells so that sucrose solution can move up and down the phloem; contain no cytoplasm so that a continuous column of water can move up the xylem vessels
